issue.title: Unowned ACE TUI pilot nodes exceed the flake baseline (screenshot export, directive completion, workflow async, proc inventory, new-project drafts)

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by phase sase-1ou.1 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2, class (d) "stale TUI pilot load-flake cluster") and filed by the sase-1ou land agent on 2026-10-28.

These ACE TUI nodes exceed `tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt` in `.venv/bin/python tools/selection_health --fail-on-new-flake`. None has an open or closed owning bead; the bead search in this triage covered every node name. All pass focused at sase master 86c3250e69 (2026-10-28, 42 passed at -n 8 for the full 41-node exceedance batch). The other nodes phase 1 listed in the same note already have owners. Open: sase-1al (panel_shell semicolon) and sase-19m (agy usage probe). Closed done on 2026-10-26 after their last failure: sase-1g2, sase-1fy, sase-1fn, sase-1ak, sase-1ib and sase-1k4. Those are not covered here.

Per-node evidence (records with at most 5 failures, 30-day window):
- `tests/ace/tui/test_screenshot_export.py::test_app_export_body_tolerates_signal_task_refresh_wait_error`: 3 gate-countable failure records (1 on clean trees), 2026-10-02 .. 2026-10-28; last record `20261028T141848Z-3d52c6ce744b-2601268-full-run.json`
- `tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_directive_completion_candidates.py::test_directive_completion_includes_representative_descriptions`: 6 gate-countable failure records (1 on clean trees), 2026-10-08 .. 2026-10-09; last record `20261009T073229Z-bd830064cadc-3810204-full-run.json`
- `tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_directive_completion_candidates.py::test_directive_completion_matches_aliases_to_canonical_insertions`: 5 gate-countable failure records (2 on clean trees), 2026-10-02 .. 2026-10-02; last record `20261002T185017Z-34079430e3bf-1978488-full-run.json`
- `tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_directive_completion_interactions.py::test_ctrl_t_at_alias_partial_inserts_canonical_directive`: 5 gate-countable failure records (2 on clean trees), 2026-10-02 .. 2026-10-02; last record `20261002T185017Z-34079430e3bf-1978488-full-run.json`
- `tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_directive_completion_interactions.py::test_percent_partial_auto_opens_directive_panel`: 5 gate-countable failure records (2 on clean trees), 2026-10-02 .. 2026-10-02; last record `20261002T185017Z-34079430e3bf-1978488-full-run.json`
- `tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_display_workflow_async.py::test_workflow_snapshot_render_reads_state_once_and_uses_parsed_data`: 21 gate-countable failure records (0 on clean trees), 2026-10-11 .. 2026-10-13; last record `20261013T104616Z-3c08c4676ff4-1846333-full-run.json`
- `tests/ace/tui/test_proc_producer_inventory.py::test_inventory_matches_live_production_source`: 3 gate-countable failure records (0 on clean trees), 2026-09-28 .. 2026-10-24; last record `20261024T115432Z-c793bff54b03-1835269-full-run.json`
- `tests/ace/tui/modals/test_new_project_create_flow.py::test_owner_switch_preserves_per_owner_drafts`: 3 gate-countable failure records (0 on clean trees), 2026-10-18 .. 2026-10-18; last record `20261018T224051Z-457dd728d517-3052454-full-run.json`

The nodes are grouped by evidence state, not by a proven shared root cause. The worker should split them by root cause (for example the four directive-completion nodes that failed together on 2026-10-02, or the workflow_async burst of 10-11..10-13). Fix the real flakes, and close the rest as their records age out with no recurrence. The land agent added these nodes to the baseline under this bead.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1ou.1 left these TUI exceedances without an owner as class (d), and the flake-baseline gate requires a filed bead for every exceedance.
